targets.rawSql: SELECT event_type, count() AS events FROM analytics.events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY events DESC

SELECT countIf(event_type='order_created') AS created, countIf(event_type='payment_authorized') AS authorized, countIf(event_type='order_confirmed') AS confirmed, round(100 * countIf(event_type='order_confirmed') / greatest(countIf(event_type='order_created'), 1), 1) AS conversion_pct FROM analytics.events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

SELECT toStartOfHour(occurred_at) AS time, sum(amount_minor) / 100.0 AS authorized FROM analytics.events WHERE event_type = 'payment_authorized' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfHour(occurred_at) AS time, -sum(amount_minor) / 100.0 AS refunded FROM analytics.events WHERE event_type = 'payment_refunded' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT reason, count() AS failures FROM analytics.events WHERE event_type = 'payment_failed' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY reason ORDER BY failures DESC

panels.title: Orders: confirmed vs fulfilled vs cancelled / day

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS time, sumIf(events, event_type = 'order_confirmed') AS confirmed, sumIf(events, event_type = 'order_fulfilled') AS fulfilled, sumIf(events, event_type = 'order_cancelled') AS cancelled FROM analytics.funnel_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
